title: mut.manual
mutation_directive: BUILD REAL 3D DEPTH: extrude the light-string forms into thick 3D ribbons, stack them at Z-depths from -3 to +3, rotate each ribbon independently into 3D space. Use bright warm-white emissive materials on the ribbons, deep black background. When the camera orbits, the ribbons should visually separate and show true parallax layering. Add a floor plane with shadow to anchor the 3D space. High contrast — vivid bright ribbons against dark void.
